acceptanceCriteria: The assemble-stable result's nextActions name the verify command (cem verify / verify-stable) and the artifact location for the map it produced; test asserts the emitted next action runs and returns ACCEPT on the fixture.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1329 comment (2026-10-20 15:54). After plain assembly there is no supported verify route named: cem prepare nextActions point --artifacts at the repository root and assume a committed producer map; verifying required copying the assembled map into a scratch clone. Related to V1-2097 (PR #1337 makes status/verify accept out-of-repository maps).
title: assemble-stable result names no verify route for the map it produced
